nyc-fse.form_seen: Application for Permit and Supplemental Application (NYC Business, Food Service Establishment Permit)

attach.en: Proof that Health Code fines are paid
attach.zh: 已缴清卫生法规罚款的证明

attach.en: Food Protection Certificate, or course registration
attach.zh: 食品保护证书或课程报名证明

attach.en: Certificate of Authority to Collect Sales Tax (address must match)
attach.zh: 销售税征收授权证书（地址须一致）

attach.en: Workers' compensation and disability insurance certificates naming DOHMH as certificate holder, or Form CE-200 if exempt
attach.zh: 将 DOHMH 列为证书持有人的工伤及残疾保险证明，或豁免时的 CE-200 表

attach.en: Power of Attorney/Authority to Act form if someone else applies
attach.zh: 如由他人代办，需授权书

destination.evidence: Applied for online at NYC Business, or in person; a valid email address is required when applying online.

nyc-fse.notes: Fee $280, plus $25 for frozen desserts. Supplemental Application and optional Wheelchair Friendly Survey are part of the online application.

nyc-sign.form_seen: DOB NOW: Build sign job filing (guided filing)

fields.en: House number and street name
Borough, block and lot
Apartment/suite number
Floor number and description of work
Applicant e-mail, license type and license number
fields.zh: 申请人邮箱、执照类型与执照号

fields.en: Filing review type
Estimated new work costs ($)
Building type
Job description for new work
Zoning district(s), overlay(s), special district(s) and map number
fields.zh: 分区、叠加区、特别区及地图编号

fields.en: Lessee email and relationship to owner
fields.zh: 承租人邮箱及与业主关系

fields.en: Sign purpose
Material of the sign and weight
Total surface area of this sign (sq ft)
fields.zh: 本招牌总面积（平方英尺）

fields.en: Total zoning lot frontage
Total surface area of all signs on the zoning lot, and the maximum allowed
fields.zh: 该地块所有招牌总面积及允许上限

fields.en: Sign type and location
Sign wording
Cost details: area or units, unit cost and description
fields.zh: 费用明细：面积或数量、单价与说明

fields.en: Owner type, owner's email and relationship to owner
fields.zh: 业主类型、业主邮箱及关系

attach.en: Sign drawings and the documents DOB NOW lists for the job
attach.zh: 招牌图纸及 DOB NOW 列出的相关文件

destination.evidence: Applicant of Record: check the box to sign electronically; the property owner must log in and attest.

nyc-sign.notes: Filed in DOB NOW: Build by a registered applicant of record (a licensed professional); the owner attests in their own login. Odelia prepares the data for the applicant of record.

nyc-co.form_seen: Certificate of Occupancy lookup and CO request (DOB NOW: Build)

fields.en: Property address (house number, street, borough)
fields.zh: 物业地址（门牌号、街道、行政区）

fields.en: Intended use of the space, to compare with the CO's floor use
fields.zh: 该空间的拟用途，用于与占用证的楼层用途核对

destination.evidence: A Certificate of Occupancy Request is submitted in DOB NOW: Build; existing buildings need a current or amended CO when there is a change in use, egress or type of occupancy.

nyc-co.notes: Mostly a check, not a filing: look up the CO in BIS (before 3/1/2021) or DOB NOW. A change of use needs a new or amended CO through an architect or engineer's DOB NOW job.

nyc-crt.form_seen: Commercial Rent Tax (annual CR-A, quarterly CR-Q)

fields.en: Location of each premises and the period occupied
fields.zh: 每处场所的位置及占用期间

fields.en: Rent required and paid (annual or annualized gross rent)
fields.zh: 应付及已付租金（年度或年化总租金）

fields.en: Each subtenant and rent received from them
Total income from the federal return, for the small business credit
fields.zh: 联邦报税表中的总收入（用于小企业抵免）

attach.en: Lease or agreement setting the rent
attach.zh: 确定租金的租约或协议

nyc-crt.notes: Applies only in Manhattan south of 96th Street when annualized gross rent is $250,000 or more; a return is still required above $200,000. Annual return due June 20; quarterly returns Sept 20, Dec 20, Mar 20.

destination.evidence: This form must be signed by the person completing it. Type or print clearly in black ink when submitting by mail or fax. Business employers may apply online at www.businessexpress.ny.gov.

ny-dol-100.notes: Online through NY Business Express is the faster route. Line E1 asks for owners' SSNs: Placetta never sends SSNs, so this line goes to the person.

fields.en: LLC name, exactly as on Department of State records
fields.zh: LLC 名称（须与州务厅记录完全一致）

fields.en: Date the articles of organization were filed
The two newspapers the notice was published in

attach.zh: 两家报纸的刊登证明书

mail.name: New York Department of State, Division of Corporations

destination.evidence: The certificate, the fee and the affidavits of publication must be submitted together to the Department of State.

ny-dos-pub.notes: Fee $50. Due within 120 days after the articles take effect; missing it suspends the LLC's authority to do business.
